about_the_game:
This soundtrack includes all songs in the Chapter 1 OST! And will be updated to include future chapters as they release.

A Rich World Full of Personality

Explore seamlessly connected and large procedurally generated levels, each with their own style of building. No one knows what you might find, and every run is so different from the last!

Create Your Playstyle!

There are sooo many ways to mix and match the expansive arsenal of items, weapons, and trinkets that you find. You can build a unique experience that perfectly fits you!


Conquer The Great Aerlysia

Each zone has its own story and lore to tell, and it’s up to you to discover it. Venture from room to room, defeat all adversaries along the way, and ultimately reclaim what was once yours…

Key Features

  • HUNDREDS of unique rooms, every run is vastly different from the last

  • Dozens of enemies that pose different challenges to the player, learn and overcome each one

  • Utilize a near infinite amount of customization from hundreds of items

  • A highly energetic and fun soundtrack!

…Secrets? Wait-what? ??

name: Terralora Soundtrack
short_description: Everything has gone to crap, you know your end will come soon enough, but you decide you’ll face your fears. Take on Beth’s final wish, set out to purify Aerlysia of all great demons, and seize the power of the Dreamstone.
